instructions.name: initializeVault
docs: Initialize a new vault for a given xStock mint and maturity timestamp.
Creates PT and YT mints, stores initial multiplier snapshot.

accounts.name: xstockMint
docs: The xStock Token-2022 mint (e.g. SPYx).

accounts.name: usdcMint
docs: USDC mint (standard SPL token)

accounts.name: vault
docs: The vault PDA. Seeds: ["vault", xstock_mint, maturity_timestamp_le_bytes]

accounts.name: ptMint
docs: PT mint â€” created here, authority = vault PDA

accounts.name: ytMint
docs: YT mint â€” created here, authority = vault PDA

accounts.name: vaultXstockAccount
docs: Vault's xStock token account (Token-2022)

accounts.name: vaultUsdcAccount
docs: Vault's USDC token account (standard SPL)

instructions.name: updateMultiplier
docs: Update the current multiplier stored in the vault (authority-controlled oracle).
Call this when the SPYx ScaledUiAmount multiplier changes on-chain.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Only the vault authority can update the multiplier

instructions.name: deposit
docs: Deposit raw xStock tokens into the vault.
Mints an equal amount of PT and YT tokens to the depositor.

accounts.name: xstockMint
docs: xStock Token-2022 mint â€” needed to read current multiplier

accounts.name: depositorXstockAccount
docs: Depositor's xStock token account (Token-2022)

accounts.name: vaultXstockAccount
docs: Vault's xStock token account

accounts.name: protocolFeeAccount
docs: Protocol fee account for SPYx (Token-2022). Owned by vault.authority, mint == vault.xstock_mint.

accounts.name: ptMint
docs: PT mint â€” vault is authority

accounts.name: ytMint
docs: YT mint â€” vault is authority

accounts.name: depositorPtAccount
docs: Depositor's PT token account (created if needed)

accounts.name: depositorYtAccount
docs: Depositor's YT token account (created if needed)

instructions.name: settle
docs: After maturity: compute excess raw tokens representing accrued dividends,
swap them to USDC via Jupiter, store usdc_per_yt for YT claims.
Can only be called once.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Anyone can call settle after maturity

accounts.name: xstockMint
docs: xStock Token-2022 mint â€” to read current multiplier

accounts.name: vaultXstockAccount
docs: Vault's xStock account â€” we transfer excess out of here

accounts.name: vaultUsdcAccount
docs: Vault's USDC account â€” will receive Jupiter swap proceeds
The caller is responsible for ensuring USDC lands here
(via a separate Jupiter swap transaction submitted in the same bundle or before)

accounts.name: protocolUsdcFeeAccount
docs: Protocol USDC fee account. Owned by vault.authority, mint == vault.usdc_mint.

accounts.name: callerXstockAccount
docs: must be a valid xStock token account owned by the caller (settler).

instructions.name: redeemPt
docs: After settlement: burn PT tokens and receive raw xStock at the snapshot ratio.

accounts.name: xstockMint
docs: xStock Token-2022 mint â€” to read current multiplier

accounts.name: vaultXstockAccount
docs: Vault's xStock account â€” source of redemption

accounts.name: redeemerXstockAccount
docs: token account for the xStock mint owned by the redeemer.

accounts.name: redeemerPtAccount
docs: Redeemer's PT token account â€” PT gets burned here

accounts.name: ptMint
docs: PT mint â€” vault burns from here

instructions.name: claimYt
docs: After settlement: burn YT tokens and receive pro-rata USDC.

accounts.name: vaultUsdcAccount
docs: Vault's USDC account â€” source of YT claim payout

accounts.name: claimerUsdcAccount
docs: Claimer's USDC account â€” receives USDC payout

accounts.name: claimerYtAccount
docs: Claimer's YT token account â€” YT gets burned here

accounts.name: ytMint
docs: YT mint â€” burned here

accounts.name: usdcMint
docs: USDC mint

instructions.name: withdraw
docs: Before settlement: burn equal PT + YT and receive raw xStock back.
Early exit â€” only callable while vault is not yet settled.

accounts.name: xstockMint
docs: xStock Token-2022 mint

accounts.name: ptMint
docs: PT mint â€” burned here

accounts.name: ytMint
docs: YT mint â€” burned here

accounts.name: withdrawerPtAccount
docs: Withdrawer's PT token account â€” PT burned from here

accounts.name: withdrawerYtAccount
docs: Withdrawer's YT token account â€” YT burned from here

accounts.name: withdrawerXstockAccount
docs: Withdrawer's xStock Token-2022 account â€” receives SPYx back
token account for the xStock mint owned by the withdrawer.

accounts.name: vaultXstockAccount
docs: Vault's xStock token account â€” source of returned SPYx

fields.name: bump
docs: Bump for this vault PDA

fields.name: xstockMint
docs: The xStock token mint (e.g. SPYx). Must be Token-2022 with ScaledUiAmount.

fields.name: ptMint
docs: The PT (Principal Token) mint â€” standard SPL mint, authority = vault PDA

fields.name: ytMint
docs: The YT (Yield Token) mint â€” standard SPL mint, authority = vault PDA

fields.name: vaultXstockAccount
docs: Vault's xStock token account

fields.name: vaultUsdcAccount
docs: Vault's USDC token account (receives proceeds from Jupiter swap at settlement)

fields.name: usdcMint
docs: USDC mint (for settlement)

fields.name: maturityTimestamp
docs: Unix timestamp after which settle/redeem/claim can be called

fields.name: multiplierAtDepositBits
docs: ScaledUiAmount multiplier snapshotted at first deposit.
Stored as f64 bits (u64) to avoid floating-point in account struct.
Read with: f64::from_bits(multiplier_at_deposit)

fields.name: totalDepositedRaw
docs: Total raw xStock deposited into this vault (across all depositors)

fields.name: totalPtOutstanding
docs: Total PT tokens outstanding (equals total_deposited_raw until redemptions)

fields.name: totalYtOutstanding
docs: Total YT tokens outstanding (equals total_deposited_raw until claims)

fields.name: usdcPerYtBits
docs: USDC per raw YT unit, set at settlement. Stored as f64 bits.
Read with: f64::from_bits(usdc_per_yt_bits)

fields.name: currentMultiplierBits
docs: Current ScaledUiAmount multiplier, updated by update_multiplier() instruction.
In production this would be read directly from SPYx TLV data;
for the hackathon this is authority-controlled to avoid spl-token-2022 version conflicts.

fields.name: settled
docs: Whether settle() has been called

fields.name: authority
docs: Creator / admin of this vault

errors.name: AlreadyMatured
errors.msg: Vault is past maturity â€” deposits are no longer accepted

errors.name: NotSettled
errors.msg: Vault has not been settled yet â€” call settle() first

errors.name: NotMatured
errors.msg: Maturity timestamp has not been reached yet

errors.name: InvalidMaturity
errors.msg: Maturity timestamp is in the past â€” must be a future timestamp

errors.name: ZeroAmount
errors.msg: Amount must be greater than zero

errors.name: InsufficientVaultBalance
errors.msg: Insufficient xStock in vault for this redemption

errors.name: MissingScaledUiAmountExtension
errors.msg: The provided mint is not a Token-2022 mint with ScaledUiAmount extension

errors.name: ZeroExcess
errors.msg: Settlement produced zero excess â€” no dividends have accrued

errors.name: ZeroUsdcPerYt
errors.msg: USDC per YT is zero â€” vault was settled with no USDC proceeds

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: Signer is not the vault authority

errors.name: WithdrawAfterSettlement
errors.msg: Cannot withdraw after vault has been settled

errors.name: FeeTooLarge
errors.msg: Fee amount equals or exceeds deposit amount -- fee rate too large

errors.name: InvalidFeeAccount
errors.msg: Protocol fee account has invalid owner or mint mismatch
